name: Utopian socialism
scope: The founding generation of utopian socialism as the defining sources name it: Saint-Simon, Fourier and Owen (Leopold, Britannica), with the later utopian communist Étienne Cabet and the communities and Owenite, Fourierist and Saint-Simonian movements they inspired; the label comes from Marx and Engels (Leopold, 'Marx, Engels, and Some (Non-Foundational) Arguments against Utopian Socialism'; Britannica 'utopian socialism'). Texts tied to it: Owen's A New View of Society, Fourier's Theory of the Four Movements, and Engels's Socialism: Utopian and Scientific as the classic account. It excludes Marxism itself, later utopian fiction and the religious communitarian settlements Britannica mentions (Shakers, Mennonites, Mormons) except where they overlap; the three founders differ (Saint-Simon technocratic, Fourier on passions and association, Owen on education and circumstances).

summary: Utopian socialism is the early 19th-century current, associated with Saint-Simon, Fourier, Owen and Cabet, that condemned competitive industrial capitalism and proposed rationally planned, cooperative communities with shared property and attractive, varied labour. Owen held that character is formed by circumstances, so crime and vice are cured by education and environment rather than punishment; the school sought change by example and persuasion, peacefully and gradually, appealing to all classes rather than to class struggle.

notes: Searched themes: economy and ownership, labour, government and the state, society and family, crime and punishment, religion, women, ecology and settlement, culture, technology, means of change, world order. Answers rest on Britannica's articles on socialism, utopian socialism, Owen and Fourier, Leopold's chapter, Owen's A New View of Society and Fourier's Theory of the Four Movements. The founders differ (Saint-Simon on planning by experts, Fourier on unequal shares, Owen on common property), so where they do not agree the answer is a split or null. The Manifesto is a critic's account and answers nothing.
